notes.text: why don't we mention the suicide here and imply it?
notes.chunk_at_written: … *You press the button, we do the rest.* It was the first true consumer company in America, and the promise was so complete that the man behind it disappeared into it. He removed himself from the product, from his gifts, from his own authorized biography, and finally from the world, on a March afternoon in 1932, with the alternative covered and a second pistol in the bookcase. The company he left ran on his instructions for eighty years without the judgment that wrote them. It gave the United States its eyes over the Soviet Union, put the first photograph of the Earth in front of humanity, and then, in a single year, 1976, invented the digital image, patented the sensor every phone now carries, licensed it out to the world, and chose to collect rent instead of build. …
notes.stood_on: The company he left ran on his instructions for eighty years without the judgment that wrote them.
notes.answered_by: A second pistol was hidden in the bookcase in case the first one failed.

notes.chunk_at_written: He also disappeared, deliberately, from everything he made. From the product, from his own gifts, from the biography he commissioned and then edited himself, and finally from the world, on an afternoon in March 1932, having arranged the room and left a note reading *my work is done, why wait.*
notes.stood_on: From the product, from his own gifts, from the biography he commissioned and then edited himself, and finally from the world, on an afternoon in March 1932, having arranged the room and left a note reading *my work is done, why wait.*
notes.answered_by: And on the afternoon of March 14, 1932, from the world: he signed his will in front of witnesses, made a joke about the pen, arranged the chairs in his bedroom, drew an outline of his heart on his chest, laid a wet towel over it, and shot himself through it.
